task:
A levy charges 11% on the first 3000 credits of a 2800-credit bill and 39% on the remainder. Subtract a 8-credit rebate from the levy (floor at zero), then apply a 7% surcharge to that reduced levy. What is the exact final levy? No rounding. After computing that result, apply these further settlement adjustments IN ORDER, with no rounding:

Adjustment 13: add 17 credits, then discount the whole amount by 18%.
Adjustment 14: apply a 11% surcharge, then subtract 9 credits.
Adjustment 15: add 23 credits, then discount the whole amount by 7%.
Adjustment 16: apply a 17% surcharge, then subtract 15 credits.
Adjustment 17: add 6 credits, then discount the whole amount by 14%.
Adjustment 18: apply a 12% surcharge, then subtract 14 credits.
Adjustment 19: add 3 credits, then discount the whole amount by 7%.
Show intermediate steps, with one line for each follow-on stage in the form Amount after adjustment <n>: <exact value>. End with Final answer: <reduced fraction, or integer if its denominator is one>.
